# Pipes
Pipes (`|`) send the output of one command as input to another.
```bash
cat file.txt | grep "word"
```
This reads the file, then searches it. You can chain as many as you want:
```bash
cat file.txt | grep "word" | wc -l
```
This counts how many lines contain "word".
